schemaVersion.description: Version of the Protein Ensemble manifest specification.

id.description: Identifier for the ensemble within its managing namespace.

contentHash.description: Content identifier for the ensemble, in the form algorithm:hexdigest.

type.description: Defines how member weights are interpreted.

normalized.description: Whether explicit member weights are normalized according to the semantic contract.

capabilitiesRequired.description: Capabilities a consumer must support to interpret this manifest.

metadata.description: Non-normative metadata. Metadata fields have no PE core semantic meaning unless explicitly defined by the specification.

uri.description: URI reference to the structural resource. Relative references are resolved relative to the manifest.

modelIndex.description: Zero-based model index within the referenced structural resource. When omitted, the referenced resource represents a single structural member.

structureHash.description: Content identifier for the referenced structural resource, in the form algorithm:hexdigest.

value.description: Member weight. Its interpretation and permitted range are defined by weightScheme and the semantic contract.
